description: This is a Java class named LoanTransactionDTO that functions as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for loan transaction details within the Fineract accounting module. It encapsulates various fields such as transaction identifiers, dates, amounts, types, and related charge/payment information, with Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.
